assumptions.statement: Exact official polygons are unavailable; repository provisional rough polygons support generation and self-check only.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics and locations must be recalculated when official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines, parcels, ownership, heritage controls, municipal capacity, and facility baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory, engineering, capacity, or approval conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Land use, paths, green/public space, and phasing are agent-generated relationships within the provisional constraint.
assumptions.impact: They are proposals, not existing conditions or approved controls.

assumptions.statement: Three building polygons are diagrammatic prototype bases only.
assumptions.impact: They are not surveyed buildings, permanent envelopes, or retain-renovate-demolish findings.

assumptions.statement: Eleven scenario cards and six gates are a document-level design contract.
assumptions.impact: They do not prove deployment, participation, accessibility, safety, compliance, or benefit.

assumptions.statement: No site owner, government unit, enterprise, university, operator, funder, or community has been represented as committed.
assumptions.impact: All roles are conceptual until separately authorized.

assumptions.statement: Staffing, budgets, dates, service levels, appeal times, emergency command, and insurance are not established.
assumptions.impact: G0-G3 and the four-season cycle are decision gates, not promises or schedules.

assumptions.statement: Each scenario is designed to work without optional AI and to minimize collection.
assumptions.impact: A lawful basis, data impact assessment, security design, retention, and deletion process must be confirmed before operation.

assumptions.statement: Equal non-AI access and human assistance are design requirements.
assumptions.impact: Field accessibility and staffing remain untested and require professional review with users.

assumptions.statement: The Centennial Time Garden is a low-impact cultural prototype.
assumptions.impact: No historic claim, precise relic location, protected boundary, or ground intervention is inferred.

assumptions.statement: Six primary public sources inform mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: Local law, actors, funding, form, performance, or partnership is not inferred.

assumptions.statement: Submission-original assets use COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY; external sources remain under their own terms.
assumptions.impact: No external image, logo, map tile, font file, or peer asset is redistributed.
